# Türkiye Grid Foundation Model

Official multilingual public research record by Faramarz Kowsari.

Project: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/turkiye-grid-foundation-model/
Repository: https://github.com/FaramarzKowsari/turkiye-grid-foundation-model
English guide: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/turkiye-grid-foundation-model/en/
Turkish guide: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/turkiye-grid-foundation-model/tr/
Spanish (Spain) guide: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/turkiye-grid-foundation-model/es/
Research status: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/turkiye-grid-foundation-model/results.html

Current status: v0.1 research scaffold. Software and synthetic smoke validation are implemented. No completed real-data confirmatory result, OSF preregistration or paper-level superiority claim is made yet.

Research focus: shared temporal representation learning for electricity consumption, renewable generation and day-ahead PTF forecasting in Türkiye, with chronological evaluation, calibrated uncertainty and negative-transfer analysis.

Zenodo v0.2.1 DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22102736
Zenodo Concept DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22102735

OSF Open-Ended Registration DOI: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/FMCYQ
Associated OSF project: https://osf.io/tz5pw
OSF registration status: accepted and public
The OSF lifecycle registration is not the final confirmatory preregistration; the confirmatory holdout remains undefined and untouched.
